Policy · Last updated August 11, 2026

Marketplace terms

Review status

Draft for owner and qualified legal review before public launch.

Free products in 0.3.1

All public offers have a zero minor-unit price in 0.3.1. Paid checkout, taxes, refunds, payouts, and payment providers are disabled even though provider-neutral records reserve a future boundary.

Entitlements

An accepted free claim creates an idempotent order and a perpetual personal or organization entitlement. Entitlement authorizes download; package hashes and signatures separately establish integrity.

Publication and changes

Published versions are immutable. Corrections require a new version. Staff may delist a product, suspend a publisher, or security-revoke a version after review. Security revocations override download access.

Reviews and reports

Only entitled owners may publish one editable review per ownership target. Reviews, replies, listings, and packages can be reported and moderated under the acceptable-use policy.
